response.description: An increased mass density of a population of organisms such that the density of organisms in an area is increased beyond sustainable levels.
response.label: overcrowded population

response.description: The density of plants in a population or organisms (a single species), often measured as the number of plants per area.
response.label: plant density of a population

response.description: The density of seedlings in a population or organisms (a single species), often measured as the number of seedlings per area.
response.label: seedling density of a population
